################################################################################ 

# 0. OVERVIEW & SETUP

################################################################################ 

This script presents sensitivity moderation analyses - two-stage meta-regressions, to complement multilevel models with interactions in the main analyses.

For main analyses, see 'Main analyses.Rmd'.

For other sensitivity analyses, see

- 'Sensitivity analysis - Excluding no denomination.Rmd' for repeat of all analyses excluding no denomination group

- 'Sensitivity analysis - Largest group.Rmd' for repeat of all analyses with the largest group as majority (rather than \>50%)

**Setup**

Load functions, file paths, and packages

We load in the file from the main analysis which has already a) removed countries with no majority (in demographics or WVS sample), b) removed countries with minorities \<1%, c) removed individuals with missing on exposure/covariates/all 3 outcomes.

################################################################################ 

# 1. REMOVE NO DENOMINATION GROUP FOR SENSITIVITY

################################################################################ 

In the main analyses all religious groups were included. However, one can argue that individuals with no denomination function differently as a religious group, for example, a no denomination minority is substantially qualitatively different from a Muslim minority in a Christian-dominant country.

In our first set of sensitivity analyses, we exclude the denomination group and re-run all analyses. Only those affiliated to a religion will be included.

```{r}
# Create no denomination excluded dataset ---- 

data_exc <- data %>% filter(religion_wrd != "No_Denomination")

# Check
data_exc %>% count(religion_wrd) # Double check 
data_exc %>% count(religion_status) # Majority: 55,523, Minority: 7,437
data_exc %>% distinct(country) %>% nrow() # 54 countries
```

```{r}
# Create factor
data_exc$country <- factor(data_exc$country)
data_exc$religion_status <- factor(data_exc$religion_status)
data_exc$religion_status %>% levels()
```

```{r}
# Remove countries with a minority <1%
country_check <- data_exc %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_majority = sum(religion_status == "Majority", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_minority = sum(religion_status == "Minority", na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_majority = 100 * n_majority / n_total,
    pct_minority = 100 * n_minority / n_total,
    n_groups = n_distinct(religion_status),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(pct_minority)
country_check %>% print(n=57)
# 3 countries have minority <1%. Czechia has no majority.

# Drop these countries
countries_drop <- country_check %>%
  filter(pct_minority < 1 | n_groups == 1) %>%
  pull(country)

data_exc <- data_exc %>%
  filter(!country %in% countries_drop)

# Check remaining countries
data_exc$country %>% unique() 
data_exc %>% count
# 39 countries left
```

```{r}
# Define function 
make_table <- function(df, country_sample_sizes) {
  
  country_religion_composition <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(religion_status)) %>%
    group_by(country) %>%
    mutate(country_n = n()) %>%
    group_by(country, religion_wrd, religion_status) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      country_n = first(country_n),
      .groups = "drop_last"
    ) %>%
    mutate(pct_of_country = n / country_n * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  majority_table <- country_religion_composition %>%
    filter(religion_status == "Majority") %>%
    select(
      country,
      majority_religion = religion_wrd,
      majority_pct = pct_of_country
    )
  
  minority_summary <- country_religion_composition %>%
    filter(religion_status == "Minority") %>%
    arrange(country, desc(pct_of_country)) %>%
    group_by(country) %>%
    summarise(
      minority_composition = paste0(
        religion_wrd, " (", round(pct_of_country, 1), "%)",
        collapse = "; "
      ),
      minority_pct_total = round(sum(pct_of_country), 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  table <- country_sample_sizes %>%
    left_join(majority_table, by = "country") %>%
    left_join(minority_summary, by = "country")

  return(table)
}
```

# 2. 2S META-ANALYSIS

```{r two-stage-meta-analysis}
make_forest_plot <- function(result) {
  outcome_var <- result$outcome
  country_estimates <- result$country_estimates
  meta_model <- result$meta_model
  
  forest_df <- country_estimates %>%
    mutate(
      ci.lb = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
      ci.ub = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
    ) %>%
    arrange(estimate)
  
  forest_df$` ` <- paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " ")
  forest_df$ci_text <- sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",
                               forest_df$estimate, forest_df$ci.lb, forest_df$ci.ub)
  
  plot_df <- forest_df[, c("country", " ", "ci_text")]
  colnames(plot_df) <- c("Country", " ", "Mean Difference [95% CI]")
  plot_df$Country <- as.character(plot_df$Country)
  
  blank_row <- c("", paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "), "")
  
  w     <- 1 / (forest_df$std.error^2)
  psize <- sqrt(w)
  psize <- psize / median(psize, na.rm = TRUE)
  psize <- pmin(pmax(psize, 0.1), 0.5)
  
  plot_df_with_overall <- rbind(
    plot_df,
    blank_row,
    c("Overall", paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " "),
      sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", meta_model$beta, meta_model$ci.lb, meta_model$ci.ub)),
    blank_row
  )
  
  overall_est    <- c(forest_df$estimate, NA, as.numeric(meta_model$beta), NA)
  overall_lower  <- c(forest_df$ci.lb,   NA, meta_model$ci.lb,            NA)
  overall_upper  <- c(forest_df$ci.ub,   NA, meta_model$ci.ub,            NA)
  overall_sizes  <- c(psize,             NA, 1,                            NA)
  is_summary_vec <- c(rep(FALSE, nrow(plot_df) + 1), TRUE, FALSE)
  overall_row    <- nrow(plot_df_with_overall) - 1
  
  p_forest <- forest(
    data       = plot_df_with_overall[, c("Country", " ", "Mean Difference [95% CI]")],
    est        = overall_est,
    lower      = overall_lower,
    upper      = overall_upper,
    sizes      = overall_sizes,
    ci_column  = 2,
    ref_line   = 0,
    xlim       = c(-2, 2),
    ticks_at   = seq(-2, 2, 1),
    is_summary = is_summary_vec,
    row_height = unit(0.38, "cm"),
    theme = forest_theme(
      base_size    = 9,
      ci_lwd       = 1.2,
      ci_Theight   = 0.2,
      odd_row_col  = "#F0F0F0",
      even_row_col = "white",
      refline_gp   = gpar(lwd = 1, lty = "dashed", col = "black"),
      summary_fill = "black",
      summary_col  = "black",
      plot_margin  = unit(c(5, 5, 15, 5), "mm")
    )
  )
  
  p_forest <- insert_text(p_forest,
                          text = paste("Disparity in", tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", outcome_var))),
                          row = 1, col = 1, part = "header", just = "left",
                          gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))
  
  p_forest <- add_border(p_forest, row = nrow(plot_df),
                         gp = gpar(lwd = 1.0, col = "black"), part = "body")
  
  p_forest <- edit_plot(p_forest, row = c(overall_row - 1, overall_row, overall_row + 1),
                        which = "background", gp = gpar(fill = "#F0F0F0", col = NA))
  p_forest <- edit_plot(p_forest, row = overall_row, col = 1, which = "text",
                        gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
  p_forest <- edit_plot(p_forest, row = overall_row, col = 3, which = "text",
                        gp = gpar(fontface = "bold"))
  
  ggsave(paste0("nodenom_forest_", outcome_var, ".jpg"), p_forest, width = 8, height = 15, dpi = 300)
  print(p_forest)
  p_forest
}

# Run once, save all three outcomes' meta results, then plot each
outcomes <- c("life_satisfaction", "happiness", "health")
meta_results <- setNames(
  lapply(outcomes, run_two_stage_meta, data = data_exc),
  outcomes
)

forest_plots <- lapply(meta_results, make_forest_plot)
```

## Overall interaction

```{r sex-interaction}
run_sex_interaction <- function(outcome_var) {
  cat("\n===== SEX INTERACTION:", toupper(outcome_var), "=====\n")
  
  formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~ religion_status * sex + age + (1 + religion_status | country)"))
  
  fit <- lmer(formula, data = data, REML = FALSE,
              control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  
  print(summary(fit))
  print(confint(fit, method = "Wald"))
  
  # Emmeans
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ religion_status | sex, at = list(sex = c(1, 2))) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(sex_f = factor(sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
           outcome = outcome_var)
  
  return(list(fit = fit, emm = emm))
}

# Run for all three outcomes
results_ls     <- run_sex_interaction("life_satisfaction")
results_happy  <- run_sex_interaction("happiness")
results_health <- run_sex_interaction("health")
```

## 2SMS

```{r split-sample}
# Split by sex
data_male <- data_exc %>% filter(sex == 1)
data_female <- data_exc %>% filter(sex == 2)

# Check numbers
data_male %>% nrow()
data_female %>% nrow()
```

```{r linear-regressions}
run_linear_reg <- function(dataset, sex_label) {
  
  outcomes <- c("life_satisfaction", "happiness", "health")
  
  results <- map_dfr(outcomes, function(outcome) {
    
    dataset %>% 
      group_by(country) %>% 
      group_modify(~ {
        fit <- tryCatch(
          lm(as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ religion_status + age + sex")), data = .x),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (is.null(fit)) return(tibble())
        
        tidy(fit) %>% 
          filter(term == "religion_statusMinority") %>% 
          select(estimate, std.error) %>% 
          mutate(outcome = outcome, sex_group = sex_label)
      }) %>% 
      ungroup()
  })
  
  return(results)
}

# Run for male and female separately
linear_reg_male <- run_linear_reg(data_male, "Male")
linear_reg_female <- run_linear_reg(data_female, "Female")

# Combine 
linear_reg_sex <- bind_rows(linear_reg_male, linear_reg_female)

```

## Sex stratification

```{r meta-analyses}
meta_analysis_sex <- linear_reg_sex %>% 
  group_by(outcome, sex_group) %>% 
  group_modify(~ {
    fit <- rma(yi = .x$estimate, sei = .x$std.error, method = "REML")
    tibble(
      estimate = fit$beta[[1]],
      se = fit$se,
      ci_lb = fit$ci.lb,
      ci_ub = fit$ci.ub,
      p = fit$pval,
      i2 = fit$I2
    )
  }) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = factor(outcome,
                     levels = c("life_satisfaction", "happiness", "health"),
                     labels = c("Life satisfaction", "Happiness", "Health")),
    sex_group = factor(sex_group, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )

print(meta_analysis_sex)
```

# 3. MODERATION BY COUNTRY-LEVEL INDICATORS

```{r macro-predictors-dataset}
# Create country macro-predictors dataset
country_data <- data_exc %>% 
  group_by(country) %>% 
  summarise(
    gri_matched = first(gri_matched),
    shi_matched = first(shi_matched),
    democracy_matched = first(democracy_matched),
    gdp_matched = first(gdp_matched),
    gini_matched = first(gini_matched)
  )
```

Create pipeline and re-run models

```{r outcome-pipeline-nodenom, results = 'markup'}
library(ggrepel)
library(broom.mixed)
library(purrr)

run_outcome_pipeline <- function(outcome_var, input_data) {
  
  df <- input_data
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  cat("  OUTCOME:", toupper(gsub("_", " ", outcome_var)), "\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  
  f <- function(rhs) as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", rhs))
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      log_gdp = if ("log_gdp" %in% names(df)) log_gdp else log(gdp_matched),
      gri_category = case_when(
        gri_matched >= 6.6 ~ "Very High",
        gri_matched >= 4.5 ~ "High",
        gri_matched >= 2.4 ~ "Moderate",
        gri_matched >= 0.0 ~ "Low"
      ),
      gri_category = factor(gri_category, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High")),
      shi_category = case_when(
        shi_matched >= 7.2 ~ "Very High",
        shi_matched >= 3.6 ~ "High",
        shi_matched >= 1.5 ~ "Moderate",
        shi_matched >= 0.0 ~ "Low"
      ),
      shi_category = factor(shi_category, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High"))
    )
  
  # 1. Null model
  cat("\n===== NULL MODEL =====\n")
  null_mod <- lmer(f("1 + (1 | country)"), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(null_mod))
  vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(null_mod))
  var_country <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "country" & vc$var1 == "(Intercept)"]
  var_resid <- attr(VarCorr(null_mod), "sc")^2
  VPC <- var_country / (var_country + var_resid)
  cat("VPC:", VPC, "(", VPC * 100, "%)\n")
  
  # 2. Unadjusted
  cat("\n===== UNADJUSTED MODEL =====\n")
  ls_unadj <- lmer(f("religion_status + (1 | country)"), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(ls_unadj))
  print(confint(ls_unadj, method = "Wald"))
  
  # 3. Adjusted
  cat("\n===== ADJUSTED MODEL =====\n")
  ls_adj <- lmer(f("religion_status + age + sex + (1 | country)"), data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(ls_adj))
  print(confint(ls_adj, method = "Wald"))
  
  # 4. Random slope
  cat("\n===== RANDOM SLOPE MODEL =====\n")
  ls_slope <- lmer(f("religion_status + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)"),
                   data = df, REML = FALSE,
                   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  print(summary(ls_slope))
  print(confint(ls_slope, method = "Wald"))
  
  # 5. Likelihood ratio test
  cat("\n===== LOG LIKELIHOOD TEST =====\n")
  LR    <- 2 * (as.numeric(logLik(ls_slope)) - as.numeric(logLik(ls_adj)))
  df_ll <- attr(logLik(ls_slope), "df") - attr(logLik(ls_adj), "df")
  p     <- pchisq(LR, df = df_ll, lower.tail = FALSE)
  cat("LR:", LR, "df:", df_ll, "p:", p, "\n")
  
  # Helper: continuous predictor plot
  plot_continuous <- function(fit, predictor, x_label, df) {
    at_list <- list(seq(min(df[[predictor]], na.rm = TRUE),
                        max(df[[predictor]], na.rm = TRUE),
                        length.out = 20))
    names(at_list) <- predictor
    
    emm_levels <- emmeans(fit,
                          as.formula(paste("~ religion_status |", predictor)),
                          at = at_list)
    emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm_levels) %>%
      mutate(religion_status = as.character(religion_status))
    emm_df_slim <- emm_df %>% select(religion_status, all_of(predictor), emmean)
    
    country_means <- df %>%
      group_by(country, religion_status) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_out = mean(.data[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
        pred_val = mean(.data[[predictor]], na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        pred_snapped = as.numeric(sapply(pred_val, function(d) {
          emm_df_slim[[predictor]][which.min(abs(emm_df_slim[[predictor]] - d))]
        }))
      ) %>%
      rename(!!predictor := pred_snapped) %>%
      left_join(emm_df_slim, by = c("religion_status", predictor)) %>%
      mutate(residual = mean_out - emmean)
    
    outlier_countries <- country_means %>%
      group_by(religion_status) %>%
      mutate(z_resid = scale(residual)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(abs(z_resid) > 1.5) %>%
      pull(country) %>%
      unique()
    
    country_outliers <- country_means %>% filter(country %in% outlier_countries)
    
    p <- ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = emmean, color = religion_status)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL, fill = religion_status),
                  alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
      geom_point(data = country_means,
                 aes(x = pred_val, y = mean_out, size = n, color = religion_status),
                 alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_size_continuous(name = "Sample size", range = c(2, 10)) +
      geom_text_repel(data = country_outliers,
                      aes(x = pred_val, y = mean_out, label = country),
                      size = 3, max.overlaps = 15, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Majority" = "#04BFAF", "Minority" = "#0B2A5B")) +
      labs(x = x_label, y = paste("Mean", gsub("_", " ", outcome_var)),
           title = paste(tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", outcome_var)),
                         "by minority/majority status across", x_label),
           color = "Religion status", fill = "Religion status") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    
    ggsave(paste0("nodenom_emmeans_", predictor, "_", outcome_var, ".jpg"),
           p, width = 12, height = 6.8, dpi = 300)
    print(p)
  }
  
  # Helper: categorical predictor plot + corrected simple effects
  plot_categorical <- function(fit, predictor, x_label, df) {
    emm_cat <- emmeans(fit, as.formula(paste("~ religion_status |", predictor)))
    emm_df_cat <- as.data.frame(emm_cat) %>%
      mutate(religion_status = as.character(religion_status))
    
    country_means <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor]])) %>%
      group_by(country, religion_status, .data[[predictor]]) %>%
      summarise(mean_out = mean(.data[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(emm_df_cat %>% select(religion_status, all_of(predictor), emmean),
                by = c("religion_status", predictor)) %>%
      mutate(residual = mean_out - emmean)
    
    outlier_countries <- country_means %>%
      group_by(religion_status) %>%
      mutate(z_resid = scale(residual)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(abs(z_resid) > 1.5) %>%
      pull(country) %>%
      unique()
    
    country_outliers <- country_means %>% filter(country %in% outlier_countries)
    
    p <- ggplot(emm_df_cat, aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = emmean,
                                color = religion_status, group = religion_status)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.2) +
      geom_point(data = country_means,
                 aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = mean_out, size = n, color = religion_status),
                 alpha = 0.4,
                 position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.05, dodge.width = 0.3)) +
      scale_size_continuous(name = "Sample size", range = c(1, 7)) +
      geom_text_repel(data = country_outliers,
                      aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = mean_out, label = country),
                      size = 3, max.overlaps = 15, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Majority" = "#04BFAF", "Minority" = "#0B2A5B")) +
      labs(x = x_label, y = paste("Mean", gsub("_", " ", outcome_var)),
           title = paste(tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", outcome_var)),
                         "by religious status across", x_label),
           color = "Religion status") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    
    ggsave(paste0("nodenom_emmeans_", predictor, "_", outcome_var, ".jpg"),
           p, width = 12, height = 6.8, dpi = 300)
    print(p)
    
    # Simple effects: Minority − Majority gap at each category
    gaps <- pairs(emm_cat, reverse = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n--- Simple effects (unadjusted) ---\n")
    print(summary(gaps, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
    
    cat("\n--- Simple effects (mvt-adjusted across", nlevels(df[[predictor]]), "categories) ---\n")
    gaps_adj <- summary(gaps, by = NULL, adjust = "mvt", infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
    print(gaps_adj)
    
    invisible(gaps_adj)
  }
  
  # 6. GRI continuous
  cat("\n===== GRI CONTINUOUS =====\n")
  fit_gri <- lmer(f("religion_status * gri_matched + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)"),
                  data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(fit_gri)); print(confint(fit_gri, method = "Wald", level = 0.90))
  plot_continuous(fit_gri, "gri_matched", "Government Restrictions Index (GRI)", df)
  
  # 7. GRI categorical
  cat("\n===== GRI CATEGORICAL =====\n")
  fit_gri_cat <- lmer(f("religion_status * gri_category + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)"),
                      data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(fit_gri_cat)); print(confint(fit_gri_cat, method = "Wald", level = 0.90))
  gri_simple <- plot_categorical(fit_gri_cat, "gri_category", "Government Restrictions Index (GRI)", df)
  
  # 8. SHI continuous
  cat("\n===== SHI CONTINUOUS =====\n")
  fit_shi <- lmer(f("religion_status * shi_matched + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)"),
                  data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(fit_shi)); print(confint(fit_shi, method = "Wald", level = 0.90))
  plot_continuous(fit_shi, "shi_matched", "Social Hostilities Index (SHI)", df)
  
  # 9. SHI categorical
  cat("\n===== SHI CATEGORICAL =====\n")
  fit_shi_cat <- lmer(f("religion_status * shi_category + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)"),
                      data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(fit_shi_cat)); print(confint(fit_shi_cat, method = "Wald", level = 0.90))
  shi_simple <- plot_categorical(fit_shi_cat, "shi_category", "Social Hostilities Index (SHI)", df)
  
  # 10. Democracy
  cat("\n===== DEMOCRACY =====\n")
  fit_dem <- lmer(f("religion_status * democracy_matched + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)"),
                  data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(fit_dem)); print(confint(fit_dem, method = "Wald", level = 0.90))
  plot_continuous(fit_dem, "democracy_matched", "Democracy Index", df)
  
  # 11. GDP
  cat("\n===== GDP =====\n")
  fit_gdp <- lmer(f("religion_status * log_gdp + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)"),
                  data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(fit_gdp)); print(confint(fit_gdp, method = "Wald", level = 0.90))
  plot_continuous(fit_gdp, "log_gdp", "Log GDP per capita", df)
  
  # 12. Gini
  cat("\n===== GINI =====\n")
  fit_gini <- lmer(f("religion_status * gini_matched + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)"),
                   data = df, REML = FALSE)
  print(summary(fit_gini)); print(confint(fit_gini, method = "Wald", level = 0.90))
  plot_continuous(fit_gini, "gini_matched", "Gini Index", df)
  
  invisible(list(
    null = null_mod, unadj = ls_unadj, adj = ls_adj, slope = ls_slope,
    gri = fit_gri, gri_cat = fit_gri_cat, gri_simple = gri_simple,
    shi = fit_shi, shi_cat = fit_shi_cat, shi_simple = shi_simple,
    democracy = fit_dem, gdp = fit_gdp, gini = fit_gini
  ))
}

set.seed(2026)
results_ls_nodenom     <- run_outcome_pipeline("life_satisfaction", data_exc)
results_happy_nodenom  <- run_outcome_pipeline("happiness", data_exc)
results_health_nodenom <- run_outcome_pipeline("health", data_exc)
```

```{r nodenom-summary-tables}
all_nodenom <- list(life_satisfaction = results_ls_nodenom,
                    happiness         = results_happy_nodenom,
                    health            = results_health_nodenom)

# 1. Overall minority − majority gap (random slope model, 95% CI, α = 0.05)
main_gap_nodenom <- imap_dfr(all_nodenom, function(res, outcome) {
  tidy(res$slope, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE,
       conf.level = 0.95, conf.method = "Wald") %>%
    filter(term == "religion_statusMinority") %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome)
}) %>%
  transmute(outcome, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value,
            clear = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "yes", "no"))

knitr::kable(main_gap_nodenom, digits = 3,
             caption = "Excluding no denomination: overall minority − majority gap (95% CI, α = 0.05)")

# 2. All interaction terms (90% CI, α = 0.10)
interactions_nodenom <- imap_dfr(all_nodenom, function(res, outcome) {
  map_dfr(c("gri", "gri_cat", "shi", "shi_cat", "democracy", "gdp", "gini"), function(m) {
    tidy(res[[m]], effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE,
         conf.level = 0.90, conf.method = "Wald") %>%
      filter(grepl(":", term)) %>%
      mutate(model = m)
  }) %>% mutate(outcome = outcome)
}) %>%
  transmute(outcome, model,
            term = gsub("religion_statusMinority:", "", term),
            estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value,
            clear = if_else(p.value < 0.10, "yes", "no"))

knitr::kable(interactions_nodenom, digits = 3,
             caption = "Excluding no denomination: interaction terms (90% Wald CI, α = 0.10)")

# 3. Omnibus test of category interactions (α = 0.10)
omnibus_nodenom <- imap_dfr(all_nodenom, function(res, outcome) {
  map_dfr(c(GRI = "gri_cat", SHI = "shi_cat"), function(m) {
    a   <- anova(res[[m]])
    row <- a[grepl(":", rownames(a)), ]
    tibble(F = row$`F value`, NumDF = row$NumDF, DenDF = row$DenDF, p.value = row$`Pr(>F)`)
  }, .id = "index") %>% mutate(outcome = outcome)
}) %>%
  transmute(outcome, index, F, NumDF, DenDF, p.value,
            clear = if_else(p.value < 0.10, "yes", "no"))

knitr::kable(omnibus_nodenom, digits = 3,
             caption = "Excluding no denomination: omnibus test of religion status × category (α = 0.10)")

# 4. Corrected simple effects (mvt-adjusted 95% CI, α = 0.05)
simple_effects_nodenom <- imap_dfr(all_nodenom, function(res, outcome) {
  bind_rows(
    GRI = as.data.frame(res$gri_simple) %>% rename(category = gri_category),
    SHI = as.data.frame(res$shi_simple) %>% rename(category = shi_category),
    .id = "index"
  ) %>% mutate(outcome = outcome)
}) %>%
  rename(any_of(c(lower.CL = "asymp.LCL", upper.CL = "asymp.UCL"))) %>%
  transmute(outcome, index, category = as.character(category), estimate,
            lower.CL, upper.CL, p.value,
            clear = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "yes", "no"))

knitr::kable(simple_effects_nodenom, digits = 3,
             caption = "Excluding no denomination: minority − majority gap by category (mvt-adjusted 95% CI, α = 0.05)")
```

```{r figure4, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=8}
outcome_var <- "life_satisfaction"

df <- data %>%
  mutate(
    gri_category = factor(case_when(
      gri_matched >= 6.6 ~ "Very High",
      gri_matched >= 4.5 ~ "High",
      gri_matched >= 2.4 ~ "Moderate",
      gri_matched >= 0.0 ~ "Low"
    ), levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High")),
    shi_category = factor(case_when(
      shi_matched >= 7.2 ~ "Very High",
      shi_matched >= 3.6 ~ "High",
      shi_matched >= 1.5 ~ "Moderate",
      shi_matched >= 0.0 ~ "Low"
    ), levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High"))
  )

panel_categorical <- function(predictor, x_label) {
  fit <- lmer(as.formula(paste0(
    outcome_var, " ~ religion_status * ", predictor,
    " + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)")),
    data = df, REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
  
  emm <- emmeans(fit, as.formula(paste("~ religion_status |", predictor)))
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    mutate(religion_status = as.character(religion_status))
  
  country_means <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[predictor]])) %>%
    group_by(country, religion_status, .data[[predictor]]) %>%
    summarise(mean_out = mean(.data[[outcome_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
              n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  cat("\n===== ", toupper(predictor), " =====\n", sep = "")
  print(summary(pairs(emm, reverse = TRUE), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  
  ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = emmean,
                     color = religion_status, group = religion_status)) +
    geom_point(data = country_means,
               aes(x = .data[[predictor]], y = mean_out, size = n,
                   color = religion_status),
               alpha = 0.25,
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.05,
                                               dodge.width = 0.3)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = asymp.LCL, ymax = asymp.UCL), width = 0.15) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Sample size", range = c(1, 6)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Majority" = "#04BFAF",
                                  "Minority" = "#0B2A5B"),
                       name = "Religion status") +
    labs(x = x_label, y = "Mean life satisfaction") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}

p_gri <- panel_categorical("gri_category", "Government Restrictions Index")
p_shi <- panel_categorical("shi_category", "Social Hostilities Index")

combined <- (p_gri / p_shi) +

    tag_levels = "A",

ggsave("nodenom_emmeans_lifesatisfaction_GRI_SHI.svg", plot = combined,
```

Run moderation

```{r moderation-minority-group-size}
# Interaction built by hand: group size applies to minorities only (0 for majorities),
# centred at 10%. Coefficient = change in the minority–majority gap per percentage point.
data_exc <- data_exc %>%
  mutate(minority_x_size = if_else(religion_status == "Minority", pct_own_group - 10, 0))

run_minsize <- function(outcome_var) {
  cat("\n===== MINORITY GROUP SIZE (EXCL. NO DENOMINATION):",
      toupper(gsub("_", " ", outcome_var)), "=====\n")
  fit <- lmer(
    as.formula(paste(outcome_var,
                     "~ religion_status + minority_x_size + age + sex + (1 + religion_status | country)")),
    data = data_exc, REML = FALSE,
    control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
  )
  print(summary(fit))
  
  ci90 <- confint(fit, parm = "minority_x_size", method = "Wald", level = 0.90)
  ci95 <- confint(fit, parm = "religion_statusMinority", method = "Wald", level = 0.95)
  
  cat("\nGap for a 10% minority (95% CI):",
      round(fixef(fit)["religion_statusMinority"], 3), "[",
      round(ci95[1], 3), ",", round(ci95[2], 3), "]\n")
  cat("Change in gap per 10 pp larger minority (90% CI):",
      round(10 * fixef(fit)["minority_x_size"], 3), "[",
      round(10 * ci90[1], 3), ",", round(10 * ci90[2], 3), "]\n")
  fit
}

fit_minsize_ls_exc     <- run_minsize("life_satisfaction")
fit_minsize_happy_exc  <- run_minsize("happiness")
fit_minsize_health_exc <- run_minsize("health")
```
